title: Minimum Number Of Operations To Make Array Empty
description:
In one operation, remove either two or three equal elements from `nums`. Return the minimum number of operations needed to remove every element, or `-1` if it is impossible.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [3, 3, 4, 3, 4]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: nums = [2, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3]
Output: -1
```

## Constraints

- `2 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6`
